content: Word embeddings were first introduced in BIBREF2 , BIBREF3 and there have been many variants BIBREF4 , BIBREF5 , BIBREF6 , BIBREF7 . Common for all of them is the idea that words can be represented by latent feature vectors. These feature vectors are optimized to maximize the conditional probability of the dataset. Recently BIBREF1 extended the idea of word embeddings to other types of data. EqEmb expand the idea of word embeddings to a new type of data points – equations.
